note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot. Plan sizes from the trace of the straight front photo (44 mm across the 9-3 flats, listing; strap 21.91 mm measured). Heights before the house depth scale (11 mm thick listing). Dial print, indices, logo, minute track and the strap leather come from one photo map.

case.note: [kind, inset from the 16-gon (poly) or radius (round), z]: flank, small top chamfer, sloped outer bezel band (photo grey band), near-flat bezel top to the inner polygon edge, round inner bevel down to the crystal seat

guard.note: crown guard shoulder (right silhouette), its top falling toward the crown (dark in the photo)

marker.note: two red stripes on the bezel at 12 (photo), following the sloped bezel top

lug.note: wide polished lugs with a sloped top and a slanted tip (front photo and 3/4 view)

dial.note: flat dial to the minute track dots, then a shallow cone up to the crystal seat

hands.note: white sword hands with grey edges and black tips (hour: round-ended needle, minute: lance), the black AX fork over both, black seconds needle with a white stripe and red tip

crown.note: steel crown at 3: smooth collar, fluted body, chamfered end

strap.note: House curl (SUR419P1): bend at the lug tips (25.5 mm), 7 mm radius, end_y = tip + 2.2 x radius

steel_polished.note: house polished steel: crown, hand bodies, hub

steel_brushed.note: brushed steel (photo: matte grey case, bezel, lugs and guard), house brushed roughness without the bracelet normal map

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers blur the dial behind transmission glass

lume.note: white hand tops and the seconds stripe (photo)

paint_black.note: black hand tips, AX fork, seconds needle

marker_red.note: red bezel stripes at 12 and seconds tip
